title: Upcoming running events in Kochi
description: Compare announced running events in Kochi, from shorter races to marathons.
intro: These announced races offer a range of distances. Dates and registration information can change, so check each event's linked source before making plans. This list covers Kochi rather than all of Ernakulam district.

entries.name: Orange Run 2026
entries.description: A Kochi running event on 1 November 2026, with a half marathon and shorter-distance categories. The registration page lists 26 October as the registration deadline.
entries.details: Date: 1 November 2026 · Venue: Cochin Port Trust Stadium, Willingdon Island · Running distances include 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km.

entries.name: SBI Kochi Navy Half Marathon 2026
entries.description: Organized by Southern Naval Command, the event is scheduled for 13 December 2026 and includes a half marathon, a timed 10 km run and a 5 km fun run.
entries.details: Date: 13 December 2026 · Distances: 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km · Start: Grand Hyatt Convention Center · Finish: Bolgatty Palace Ground.

entries.name: Federal Bank Kochi Marathon 2027
entries.description: The fifth edition is scheduled for 14 February 2027, with full-marathon, half-marathon, 10 km and 3 km categories.
entries.details: Date: 14 February 2027 · Distances: 42.195 km, 21.097 km, 10 km and 3 km · The route has not yet been finalized.
